acceptanceCriteria: Manual publish_existing_tag recovery plans governance against the current workflow orchestration revision and selects the active Contract whose base is the merge parent, while the immutable target tag remains the artifact source identity.
Build jobs cannot start unless release_preflight, source_quality, and release_tools all succeed; a source-quality failure stops dependent expensive work.
Existing normal push/tag and non-recovery dispatch behavior remains compatible, and recovery source checkout still uses the requested immutable tag.
The workflow policy regression fails on the old dependency/identity wiring and passes on the corrected wiring.
Local focused tests, Runtime preflight/checkpoint/verify, hosted PR checks, and a single post-merge recovery run provide evidence without moving or overwriting v0.2.91.
goal: Make recovery route planning bind to the current orchestration main Contract while artifact jobs remain bound to the immutable requested tag, and require source quality to pass before the build matrix can start.
intent: Repair the post-merge v0.2.91 recovery release route after hosted run 34672303796 exposed wrong governance identity selection and expensive build scheduling after source-quality failure.
outOfScope: existing v0.2.91 tag or Release identity

workflow diff and policy regression output
post-merge release run and public artifact acceptance evidence
